title: Clearing the next captured cell
statement: Let $p$ be a natural number, $b$ a Boolean value, and $r$ a finite Boolean list. Blanking cell $p$ of the sparse tape determined by $p$ blank entries followed by the entries $b$ and $r$ gives the sparse tape determined by $p+1$ blank entries followed by $r$.
replaced:
For every $p$, every bit $b$, and every boolean word $\mathit{rest}$, blanking
position $p$ of the sparse tape consisting of $p$ blank cells followed by the
symbols of the word $b$ then $\mathit{rest}$ yields the sparse tape of $p + 1$ blank
cells followed by the symbols of $\mathit{rest}$.
